stories.title: Browse and select a product offer from the catalog
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-CATALOG-01: Catalog endpoint returns available offers for the customer's market context
AC-CATALOG-02: Each offer includes pricing summary (once-off and/or recurring), title, and CTA label
AC-CATALOG-03: Promotional offers are flagged with a badge and isPromotional flag
AC-CATALOG-04: Prepaid upsell and migration offers are distinguishable by type field

stories.title: Capture customer identity and delivery details at checkout
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-FIELDS-01: Journey fields endpoint returns step-1 customer detail fields (firstName, lastName, email, phone, deliveryAddress)
AC-FIELDS-02: All required fields are marked required=true and carry a businessPurpose description
AC-FIELDS-03: Marketing consent checkbox is presented at step 1 as optional
AC-FIELDS-04: Fields are scoped to collectionStep 1

stories.title: Tokenize payment method for PCI-DSS compliant order settlement
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-PAYMENT-01: Payment token field is presented at step 2 (collectionStep=2), after customer details
AC-PAYMENT-02: Raw card data is never stored; only a payment token is submitted
AC-PAYMENT-03: Billing postal code is collected as optional context at step 2
AC-PAYMENT-04: Order creation accepts a paymentAttemptId and paymentStatus field
AC-PAYMENT-05: Mobile Money is available as an alternative settlement method

stories.title: Submit and confirm a product order
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-ORDER-01: POST /api/orders creates an order and returns an ORD-XXXXXX reference
AC-ORDER-02: Order confirmation includes lineItems, onceOffTotal, monthlyTotal, paymentStatus, and nextSteps
AC-ORDER-03: Order creation emits an order_created audit event into the consent/audit sink
AC-ORDER-04: Missing required fields (cartId, paymentAttemptId, paymentStatus, lineItems) return HTTP 422 with field-level errors
AC-ORDER-05: Each order reference is unique (collision-resistant random generation)

stories.title: Complete RICA/KYC identity verification for SIM registration
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-KYC-01: Onboarding journey exposes step-3 identity fields (idDocumentType, idDocumentNumber, addressLine1, city, postalCode) gated behind payment confirmation
AC-KYC-02: POST /api/onboarding/verification creates a verification case with status PENDING or PASSED
AC-KYC-03: GET /api/onboarding/verification/:orderId returns current verification case status
AC-KYC-04: eSIM issuance is blocked (HTTP 403 VERIFICATION_PENDING) until KYC/RICA status is PASSED
AC-KYC-05: Identity fields carry RICA regulatory businessPurpose descriptions

stories.title: Port an existing mobile number to the new SIM
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-PORT-01: POST /api/onboarding/porting accepts marketCode, donorNetwork, accountHolderName, accountNumber, idNumber
AC-PORT-02: Porting request returns a caseId, status, and kycStub reference
AC-PORT-03: HTTP 403 is returned with PORTING_NOT_SUPPORTED when the market does not support porting
AC-PORT-04: portingMsisdn field is available on onboarding journey step 3 as optional

stories.title: Issue an eSIM profile to the customer's device
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-ESIM-01: Activation journey collects eid (eSIM EID), deviceModel, and activationConfirmation fields
AC-ESIM-02: POST /api/orders/:id/esim/issue returns activationCode and smdpAddress on success
AC-ESIM-03: Issuance is blocked with PAYMENT_PENDING (HTTP 403) if payment status is not confirmed
AC-ESIM-04: Issuance is blocked with VERIFICATION_PENDING (HTTP 403) if KYC/RICA is not passed
AC-ESIM-05: Re-issuing an already-issued eSIM returns HTTP 200 with ALREADY_ISSUED outcome idempotently

stories.title: Track order and eSIM activation status in real time
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-STATUS-01: GET /api/orders/:id/status?scenario=<scenario> returns timeline events for the order
AC-STATUS-02: Status response includes an activationState field reflecting current provisioning progress
AC-STATUS-03: Multiple scenario stubs (e.g. pending, active, failed) are supported for demo purposes
AC-STATUS-04: Activation fields include preferredNetwork as an optional configuration band

stories.title: Check device upgrade eligibility for a customer line
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-ELIG-01: POST /api/upgrade/eligibility accepts customerId, lineId, and marketCode
AC-ELIG-02: Response indicates whether the customer is eligible for an upgrade
AC-ELIG-03: HTTP 422 is returned when any required eligibility field is missing or empty
AC-ELIG-04: Eligibility result is persisted in the upgrade session state under the eligibility key

stories.title: Retrieve device financing instalment plan options
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-FIN-01: GET /api/upgrade/financing returns an array of FinancingQuote objects
AC-FIN-02: Each quote includes monthlyAmount, termMonths, and asyncPending flag
AC-FIN-03: Financing options cover 12, 18, and 24-month terms
AC-FIN-04: asyncPending=true quotes indicate credit-bureau lookup is in progress

stories.title: Get a trade-in valuation for an existing device
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-TRADEIN-01: POST /api/upgrade/trade-in/valuation accepts brand, model, storage, and condition
AC-TRADEIN-02: Response includes a trade-in quote with estimated value and currency
AC-TRADEIN-03: Invalid condition values return HTTP 422 with VALIDATION_ERROR
AC-TRADEIN-04: Trade-in quote is persisted in upgrade session state under the tradeIn key

stories.title: Maintain stateful upgrade session across multi-step flow
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-SESSION-01: GET /api/upgrade/session returns current session state (eligibility, financing, tradeIn)
AC-SESSION-02: PUT /api/upgrade/session merges a partial patch into existing session state
AC-SESSION-03: Session is scoped per client via a session cookie or identifier
AC-SESSION-04: Patching with an array value for eligibility, financing, or tradeIn returns HTTP 422

stories.title: Capture and store customer consent records
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-CONSENT-01: Consent is recorded per purpose (terms, marketing) per order per session
AC-CONSENT-02: Each consent record captures orderId, sessionId, purpose, accepted flag, and capturedAt timestamp
AC-CONSENT-03: IP address is optionally captured for audit purposes
AC-CONSENT-04: Order creation accepts a consents array to batch-record consents at checkout

stories.title: Retrieve a full audit trail for an order journey
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-AUDIT-01: GET /api/orders/:ref/audit-trail returns ordered audit events for the order
AC-AUDIT-02: Endpoint requires x-session-token or x-operator-token; returns HTTP 401 if absent
AC-AUDIT-03: Each event includes id, eventType, occurredAt, payload, journeyRef, and actorRef
AC-AUDIT-04: Audit events cover lifecycle types: consent_capture, payment_outcome, verification_outcome, order_created, activation_status_change
AC-AUDIT-05: HTTP 404 is returned when the order reference does not exist

stories.title: Surface personalized upsell and migration offers to prepaid customers
acceptanceCriteriaRefs: AC-PERS-01: Upsell offers endpoint returns context-scoped offers (e.g. context=prepaid)
AC-PERS-02: Each offer includes offerId, type (upsell|migration), title, description, pricingSummary, and ctaLabel
AC-PERS-03: Promotional badge is present on Best Value and No Lock-in offers
AC-PERS-04: Empty array is returned when context has no matching offers
